TARS PR #60 — W3 INDEX_MERGE_AND_PROJECTION_CANONICALIZATION review scope

Authorized intentional behavior change:

- For receipt-index merge/writeIndex, existing pasCanonicalPaymentId, when present, may be used as an additional same-payment identity so multiple observations of one PAS-authoritative payment do not create multiple financial projections.
- Without canonical payment identity, preserve baseline local fallback semantics except that process-local cache must not resurrect an omitted PAS-unknown confirmed row; when matching PAS-unknown rows lack canonical proof, newer revision wins rather than source rank.
- confirmedTransferSummaryForUser uses canonical payment identity when present; otherwise preserves receiptIdentity-first, exact fallback.
- receiptLedgerSummaryForUser uses canonical payment identity when present; otherwise preserves its existing fallback.
- refreshPreliminaryReportAnalysis inherits the bounded confirmedTransferSummaryForUser behavior.
- Same canonical payment ID contributes at most one authoritative financial credit; distinct canonical payment IDs remain distinct.
- Source-only pre/rejected/archive_failed/invalid/duplicate/legacy/confirmed metadata without canonical proof must not gain new financial authority through W3 merge/projection.
- Test-only CI integration may register the existing W3 runtime through an existing receipt test and update the pinned canonical source hash; it must not alter product semantics.

Explicitly out of scope; review must BLOCK if introduced:

- PAS schema/service/transport or authority-semantics changes.
- AUTO/MANUAL confirmation-policy changes beyond preserving W1 behavior.
- W2 repair/archive housekeeping-semantics changes.
- Migration/import/seeding/backfill or global historical reclassification.
- OCR/provider/date/report/UI expansion unrelated to W3.
- Workflow/deploy/cutover/production mutation.

Review must block any broader behavioral change than the bounded W3 merge/projection canonicalization and test-only CI integration above.
